title: Horse dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- horse dancing: rearing on hind legs, front hooves in air, mane flowing -->
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='40' y='70' width='9' height='22' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='54' y='72' width='9' height='21' rx='4' fill='#A9702F'/>
  <rect x='38' y='88' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5C3B1B'/>
  <rect x='53' y='89' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='#5C3B1B'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='62' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#B5742F'/>
  <!-- chest / belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#D08B3F'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M 40 55 Q 30 40 34 26 L 46 30 Q 44 44 50 54 Z' fill='#B5742F'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M 34 26 Q 26 24 28 14 Q 36 18 40 24 Q 34 20 40 12 Q 46 18 46 28 Z' fill='#4B2E83'/>
  <path d='M 40 24 Q 34 32 40 40 L 44 36 Q 40 32 44 28 Z' fill='#6B44B8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='24' rx='13' ry='9' transform='rotate(-20 42 24)' fill='#C98236'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='20' rx='6' ry='5' transform='rotate(-20 30 20)' fill='#E8A95C'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='19' r='1.4' fill='#5C3B1B'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <path d='M 50 16 L 54 6 L 57 15 Z' fill='#B5742F'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='21' r='2.6' fill='#2E1B4F'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='20.3' r='0.9' fill='#FFF3D6'/>
  <!-- front legs lifted, dancing -->
  <path d='M 62 55 Q 76 50 80 38' stroke='#A9702F' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M 64 63 Q 80 64 86 54' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <circle cx='81' cy='36' r='5' fill='#5C3B1B'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='52' r='5' fill='#5C3B1B'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M 72 58 Q 88 56 90 44 Q 84 52 74 68 Z' fill='#4B2E83'/>
  <!-- sparkles of dancing -->
  <path d='M 18 52 l 2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 Z' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <path d='M 84 20 l 1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 Z' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <path d='M 20 34 l 1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 Z' fill='#9BF0FF'/>
</svg>
